svg.text: Sense-to-Actuation Latency Waterfall & Physical Silicon Dataflow
Empirical telemetry across N = 100,000 cycles; adapted from Brooks (1986) & Kelly (1998)

g.text: PANEL A: 8-STAGE CAUSAL SILICON HARDWARE PIPELINE (PHYSICAL DATAFLOW)
PANEL B: SENSE-TO-ACTUATION TIMELINES & TAIL SPATIAL DRIFT
PHYSICAL AI SYSTEMS LAW: DELAY IS SPATIAL DISPLACEMENT
Unguided kinetic drift scales linearly with latency: Δd = v_0 · Δt. At 1.2 m/s, an unmanaged tail latency of 28.4 ms carries the machine forward by 4.0 cm without corrective feedback,
breaching statutory clearance envelopes and driving contact forces into destructive mechanical runaway.
